entries.full_claim: No permutation-invariant population profile alone identifies the truth value of a nonconstant binary response at a named token, because swapping a 1 and 0 preserves the multiset and all such statistics while changing that named coordinate.
entries.domain: Every finite nonconstant binary vector of length at least two; executable enumeration covers lengths two through six.
all_premises: the target is a named token rather than only the multiset
entries.proof_or_source: Token_Installation_Witness_and_Mineness_Boundary_v0_1.md §3; elementary swap argument; 114 exact bounded cases.
entries.counterexample_or_limit: A token-specific longitudinal/measurement bridge can add evidence; only population summary alone is blocked.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Human-realized-agent and copy/swap cases prevent group or report invariants from fixing the actual bearer relation.

entries.full_claim: Natural and upstream-intervention traces can agree completely between a k-mediated path model and an r-to-u bypass, so those traces alone do not entail installed use of k; an off-natural do(k) intervention discriminates the declared pair.
entries.domain: Two deterministic binary structural models r:=b,k:=r,u:=k and r:=b,k:=r,u:=r under the stated do semantics.
all_premises: r,k,u are observed in the finite interface view
natural inputs and do(r) are the available initial evidence
installed use requires k to contribute to u in the declared candidate
entries.counterexample_or_limit: do(k) evidence remains relative to realization, fidelity, consistency, locality and exclusion assumptions; complete organization is not identified.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Abacus/calculator and copy/swap distinguish a mirrored or dormant state from a used state.

entries.full_claim: The R157 grounded selector, R159 typed Anchor-Bind-Use schema and all W1-W6 clauses jointly support the selected relation as actually installed in one fixed P/I/K/D instance.
entries.domain: One common actual token and interval with a fixed realization map, physically grounded anchor, actual endogenous binding/use, valid local propagation and bypass discrimination.
all_premises: same actual bearer, interval, complete signature and sorted occurrences
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Sufficient not necessary; no actual apparatus/token is supplied; false or unsupported clauses leave the application unresolved.
entries.thought_experiment_role: All four families test bearer, formation, use and report independence.

entries.full_claim: On the identical admitted C1 instance, the witnessed K-relation has its experiential structural counterpart by R159 transport, while R157 semantic underdetermination still prevents the familiar felt-mineness label without an independent B_min bridge.
entries.domain: One common P/I/K/D/Phi/h instance and one selected relation; familiar target semantics remain external to K.
all_premises: independent B_min for any familiar-mineness interpretation
entries.counterexample_or_limit: Does not derive C1, validate B_min, require body-frame organization for experience or select a unique owner.
entries.thought_experiment_role: Ancestor/formation separates selected-coordinate formation from basal experience; human-realized agent preserves nesting and overlap.
